SessionStart.note: The smallest payload of the four events probed. No prompt_id, so a SessionStart row cannot be correlated to a turn by the design's 1st-tier key; session_id is the only correlation key it shares with the other events.

verdict_rule: K1(a) — deriving the active model from a hook payload — is a go only if `model` is a top-level key of the event. It is absent on 2/2 SessionStart rows, so this event cannot source it.
observations: `model` is NOT a top-level key of SessionStart: documented as optional on the Agent tool's own input schema, but observed in 0/2 headless sessions on this host. The Agent tool schema (read from the probe session transcript's tool list) declares `model` as an optional string with enum [sonnet, opus, haiku, fable] — so the host has a notion of a per-spawn model, it just does not put one on this hook payload.
`source` is present as a key on 2/2 rows; its VALUE was not recorded (the probe writes key names only), so which source string a headless session reports is unmeasured.
SessionStart fires once per headless `claude -p` invocation (2 sessions → 2 rows), and did not fire again for the subagent spawned in scenario b.
No `permission_mode` on SessionStart, unlike UserPromptSubmit and PreToolUse on the same host — the key set is not a superset relationship across events.
